# Black Notebooks

*[Martin Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) · 2014 · *Schwarze Hefte**

A set of notebooks of reflections kept by [Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) from 1931 into the 1970s, published from 2014 onward in several volumes of the collected edition. The antisemitic passages they contain, notably on "world Judaism", reopened the debate over the links between his thought and his Nazi commitment.
